artist.name: FLETCHER
artist.short_description: FLETCHER is an Afterglow discovery artist in the broader emotional-pop and songwriter catalogue.
artist.biography: FLETCHER is the stage name of American singer-songwriter Cari Fletcher. She developed a pop catalogue centered on frank desire, complicated relationships and the uneven process of healing. Her early breakthrough releases included 'Undrunk,' 'Bitter' and songs from You Ruined New York City for Me and THE S(EX) TAPES. Girl Of My Dreams followed in 2022, featuring 'Becky's So Hot' and 'Better Version'; later albums include In Search Of The Antidote and 2025's Would You Still Love Me If You Really Knew Me?. The artist has talked openly about how breakup experiences fed the songs on Girl Of My Dreams, including the mixture of envy and fascination behind 'Becky's So Hot.' In a label statement she described 'Better Version' as accepting that people may change after a relationship ends. These first-person perspectives make FLETCHER an especially valuable addition to Afterglow's song-explanation research. The catalogue can connect high-energy pop with emotional vulnerability, but descriptions must not present media speculation about specific people as verified biographical facts. The user's requested FLETCHER is distinct from unrelated artists with the same surname.
